messages:
nora_docs: opened a short PR to add an isolation impact matrix and a one-line Terraform example for reservation requests. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1284
ash_engineering: quick ask 1: can you paste the isolation matrix text here so infra can quick-check the numbers?
nora_docs: sure, kept it compact: - soft: shared shard; prefix cache best-effort; eviction window ~30-300s; transient latency ~200ms-2s (depends on model). - hard: dedicated shard; cache persisted while node lives; eviction window ~120-600s; transient latency ~50-800ms (depends on model/quant).
raj_pm: legal flagged the phrase "eviction window" 1: can we add a parenthetical that it is target operator drain time and may vary?
nora_docs: updated to add "(operator target drain time; may vary)".
fiona_sre: nit: please add a short SLA bullet clarifying exclusions: scheduled maint, emergency hardware failures, provider reclamation, customer misconfig.
nora_docs: added SLA exclusion bullets and linked the incident-notifications runbook.
nash_engineering: terraform snippet looks fine but suggest renaming billing_plan -> reservation_level to match API.
nora_docs: changed to reservation_level in the example. pasted snippet here: ```hcl resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "tenant_acme" { tenant_id = "acme-corp" gpu_profile = "a10g" nodes = 3 reservation_level = "standard" isolation = "hard" } ```
ci-bot: PR #1284 lint checks passed (linkcheck).
raj_pm: LGTM from PM; please add a one-line changelog entry before merging.
nora_docs: will do, merging after that note. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
